phone.body:
AFH MATCH
Sample Rambler SW, Tumwater WA
List $495,000
Lease test $6,000/mo
Flow $2,454/mo
NPV $173,820
IRR 18.7%
Payback 7.3 years
ROI 13.8%
10/10 Invest
Desk screen only. Not a WABO pass.

checklist.label: Thurston, Lewis, or the Tumwater radius
checklist.detail: Thurston County, measured from 3571 Cassie Drive SW, Tumwater, WA.

checklist.label: 3+ bedrooms and 2+ baths today
checklist.detail: 3 bed / 2 bath. The plan adds garage bedrooms to reach 6 residents.

checklist.label: 2-car garage, about 400 sq ft
checklist.detail: 2 spaces. 440 sq ft meets the 400 sq ft planning minimum.

checklist.label: Level entry or ramp inside the remodel
checklist.detail: Level entry or a rambler note was confirmed.

checklist.label: $20,000 covers six months of carry
checklist.detail: At the list price, six months of principal, interest, tax, insurance, and HOA is $18,394. The cap is $20,000.

checklist.label: Sprinkler question left open
checklist.detail: Some care conversions are asked for a residential sprinkler system. That bid is not inside the $60,000 remodel. Ask the building official before you treat the budget as complete.
